senses.zh_definition: 凯瑟琳；常见英语女性名字，在马来语句子中作为人名专有名词使用。
senses.en_definition: A feminine given name used as a personal proper noun in Malay texts.
senses.ms_definition: Nama peribadi perempuan yang digunakan dalam bahasa Inggeris dan berfungsi sebagai kata nama khas apabila hadir dalam ayat bahasa Melayu.
senses.nuances: 输入键保留小写 katherine，姓名通常写 Katherine。不能仅凭该名字锁定某位人物。“纯洁”属于历史上的词源联想，不是该名字在马来语中的普通词义。释义为专名说明，并非 DBP 普通词条定义；status 沿用指定记录标签。姓名搭配仅作使用示例。[姓名资料、异体与读音](https://www.behindthename.com/name/katherine)

etymology.historical_story: Katherine descends from Greek Aikaterine, whose ultimate origin remains disputed. Early Christian tradition associated the name with Greek katharos, meaning pure, influencing its later spelling. The name spread through traditions surrounding Saint Catherine of Alexandria. That historical association explains a familiar interpretation, but does not establish purity as the original meaning. [Name history](https://www.behindthename.com/name/katherine).
